Together with their families

Saturday 20 November 2027 · Córdoba

We have spent nine years learning how to be a family of two. In November we would like to borrow one evening from each of you, and become a family of many.

Five o'clock

The ceremony

Under the old oak at the far end of the garden. Please be seated by ten to five — we are starting on time, for once.

Seven o'clock

Dinner

One long table under the lanterns. There is no seating chart and no head table. Sit beside someone you have not seen in years.

Until late

And then dancing

The band plays until one, the records go on after. Breakfast at four for anyone still standing.

The evening

Everything you need

Where

Estancia La Paz

Ascochinga, Córdoba. Forty minutes from the city, and worth every one of them.

Dress

Black tie, garden rules

Long dresses and dinner jackets, but the lawn is real grass — bring the heels you can take off.

Stay

Rooms on site

Twenty rooms are held at the estancia until 1 September. Ask us and we will send the booking code.

Children

Very welcome

There is a room with films, beds and someone kind watching over them from nine.
